last.verdict: Big profit beat and buyback were outweighed by a sales miss and lower sales outlook.

reasons.label: Sales outlook cut
reasons.text: 2026 sales forecast lowered to $4.6B–$4.9B from $4.9B–$5.2B; fewer modules expected to ship.

reasons.label: Sales missed forecasts
reasons.text: Quarterly sales fell 23% to $1.23B, below the roughly $1.28B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit beat, buyback added
reasons.text: Earnings of $5.30 a share topped the roughly $4.67 expected; $500M share buyback announced.

story: Last quarter, a big profit beat and steady outlook lifted shares 2.4%. This quarter profits beat again and margins stayed fat, but sales kept shrinking and the 2026 sales forecast was cut. Shares slipped as investors weighed U.S. tariff policy.

history.verdict: Big profit beat and steady outlook outweighed a small sales dip; shares edged up.

reasons.label: Profit well above forecasts
reasons.text: Earnings of $3.92 a share beat analyst estimates of roughly $2.74–$2.89.

reasons.label: Much fatter margins
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA margin hit 61% versus 51% a year ago, as costs fell.

reasons.label: Guidance held, sales dipped
reasons.text: Full-year targets were reaffirmed; sales fell 4% to $1.06B on terminated customer contracts.
